gates.name: Gate 0 - Carrier / Source Admissibility
gates.constraint: zeros source must already be admissible

gates.name: Gate 1 - Schema Correctness
gates.constraint: li artifact must use the single midpoint/radius schema

gates.name: Gate 2 - Checksum Consistency
gates.constraint: every li row must be bound to the same zeros checksum

gates.name: Gate 3 - Interval Containment
gates.constraint: midpoint +/- radius must form a valid finite interval

gates.name: Gate 4 - Radius Bound
gates.constraint: each radius must stay below the closure threshold

gates.name: Gate 5 - Final Closure Decision
gates.constraint: all prior gates must pass for closure to be frozen
